text:
maria: Heads-up: product wants an interactive "preview" for automatic fallback policies for next week's customer demo. Need something we can run live.
liam: Sounds doable. Do we mean a full sandbox or a lightweight preview widget?
maria: Lightweight but honest: simulate triggers, display which rule fired, and export an anonymized audit log.
raj: We already have `POST /v1/policy/dryrun` in the policy-engine that replies with a decision payload. Could wire that.
liam: Backend caveat: dryrun currently returns raw tokens and full request. We need redaction & sampling metadata.
sophia: UX idea: presets (e.g., "503 surge", "latency tail", "quota exhaustion") + a timeline that steps through matching rules with reasons. Minimal table + expandable JSON for the audit.
maria: Also need a plain-english "why" line per decision, e.g., "Latency exceeded 800ms -> soft fallback" for use in demos.
raj: Proposal for decision_reason schema: `code` (enum), `summary` (short string), `details` (optional string). Example: `{ "code": "LATENCY_HIGH", "summary": "p50>800ms", "details": "avg 920ms over 30s window" }`.
liam: We'll also want operator toggles: preview vs apply, and a copy button to send the policy to a staging apply endpoint.
sophia: For the timeline, I can mock a vertical stepper with rule cards and a small graph (latency / error rate) to the left. Keep it keyboard-friendly.
maria: Compliance asks: exports must include retention tag and operator_id when present, and redact token strings.
raj: I'll add `sample_rate`, `operator_id`, and `retention_label` to the dryrun audit event. Also add a `redacted: true` flag when we redact sensitive fields.
liam: Backend tasks: (1) add redaction + metadata to dryrun (2) export endpoint that zips audit CSV + JSON (3) feature-flag the UI. I estimate ~1 day + testing.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Dryrun enabled on staging: https://staging.api.redwood.example/policy/dryrun (since 2025-03-01).
maria: Timeline: sophia prototype by EOD tomorrow, raj implements schema changes by EOD, liam spikes UI and export on Mon. I'll prepare demo script.
sophia: Will include two presets and a "custom JSON" tab for advanced users.
raj: Quick sample policy we can use in demo: ```json
{
  "name": "demo-graceful-handback",
  "triggers": [ { "type": "status_rate", "code": 503, "threshold": 0.05 }, { "type": "latency", "p50_ms": 800 } ],
  "action": "soft_fallback",
  "sample_rate": 0.1
}
```
liam: Good. One more ask: show the fallback variant selected (model id or routing tier) in the audit so customers see where traffic would go.
maria: Agreed. Add `selected_variant` to the decision payload.
raj: Will add that in the response contract.
maria: Great coordination. Follow-ups: liam (UI spike + export), raj (dryrun schema + redaction), sophia (prototype + presets), maria (demo script). Thanks all :rocket:
